The best budget-friendly PC gaming controllers with Hall Effect joysticks available in India include popular models from local brands like Cosmic Byte and EvoFox, which offer drift-free magnetic sensors starting around ₹1,800 to ₹3,000.
Top Hall Effect Controllers in India for PC
Why Choose Hall Effect Joysticks?
No Stick Drift:: Uses magnetic magnets instead of traditional carbon-film contacts, meaning the sticks won't wear out or drift over time.
Higher Precision:: Offers smoother linear movement and improved accuracy in fast-paced shooter or racing games.
Better Longevity:: Drastically increases the lifespan of your gamepad compared to standard budget options.
You can check availability and purchase these directly via Amazon India or the Cosmic Byte Official Store.
